title: PyPSA network configuration
description: Exhaustive schema of a serialized PyPSA network configuration for PyPSA version 1.2.4 (the version pinned in environment/requirements.txt and stamped by internal/target/pypsa/emitter.go). Component and attribute definitions are converted row-for-row from the upstream attribute CSVs at github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA tag v1.2.4: pypsa/data/component_attrs/{buses,carriers,generators,global_constraints,line_types,lines,links,loads,networks,processes,shapes,shunt_impedances,storage_units,stores,sub_networks,transformer_types,transformers}.csv plus pypsa/data/components.csv and pypsa/data/standard_types/{line_types,transformer_types}.csv. PyPSA has no YAML/JSON config format of its own: a configuration is a pypsa.Network populated with components. This document models that network as JSON. The top level carries the network-level attributes (networks.csv) and one collection per component list_name mapping component name to its attributes; time-varying ('static or series') attributes accept a scalar, a per-snapshot array, or a named series reference into the `timeseries` registry. Solver-result attributes are included and flagged with 'Output:' in their descriptions and x-status 'output'. This shape mirrors what this repository emits (internal/target/pypsa): a CSV import folder loadable with pypsa.Network().import_from_csv_folder(...) containing network.csv, snapshots.csv, one <list_name>.csv per populated component collection, <list_name>-<attribute>.csv per materialized series, and the _constraints.json/_scenarios.json/_performance.json/_native.pypsa.json sidecars consumed by the generated run.py. Upstream defaults that are IEEE non-finite values are given as the string literals 'inf'/'-inf'/'NaN' (see $defs/NonFiniteNumber), and the affected attributes accept number-or-literal accordingly, since JSON cannot represent Infinity/NaN natively; an upstream default of Python None is given as JSON null.

snapshots.description: List of snapshots or time steps. All time-dependent series quantities are indexed by `network.snapshots`. To reset the snapshots, call `network.set_snapshots(new)`.

oneOf.description: Timestamp label, e.g. '2025-01-01 00:00:00' (this project's snapshots.csv format from internal/emit.SnapshotLabels) or an integer index rendered as string.

prefixItems.description: Investment period (multi-horizon: first level of the pandas.MultiIndex).

oneOf.description: Multi-horizon snapshot as a (period, timestep) pair; used when investment_periods is set.

snapshot_weightings.description: The weightings applied to each snapshot, so that snapshots can represent more than one hour or fractions of one hour. The objective weightings are used to weight snapshots in the objective function. The store weightings determine the state of charge change for stores and storage units. The generator weightings are used when calculating global constraints and energy balances. (hours)

investment_periods.description: Time periods of investment. Only used for multi investment optimisation. Years have to be integer and increasing (e.g. [2025,2030,2035]). Default is an empty pd.Index([]). (years)

items.description: Investment period year; must be integer and increasing (e.g. [2025, 2030, 2035]).

investment_period_weightings.description: Weightings applied to each investment period. Objective weightings are multiplied with all cost coefficients in the objective function of the respective investment period (e.g. used to include social discount rate). Years weighting denote the elapsed time until the subsequent investment period (e.g. used for global constraints CO2 emissions). Upstream default: 1.0 (each column defaults to a weighting of 1 per investment period).

now.description: The current snapshot/time/scenario, relevant e.g. when `network.pf()` is called without a snapshot argument.

srid.description: Spatial Reference System Indentifier for x,y coordinates of buses. It defaults to standard longitude and latitude.

crs.description: Coordinate Reference System for the Shape components. It defaults to standard longitude and latitude, given in srid.

buses.description: Bus components (Fundamental node where all components attach), keyed by unique name. Emitted as buses.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to buses-<attribute>.csv. networks.csv also lists `buses` as an Output (pandas.DataFrame of all static Bus information compiled by PyPSA from inputs: index is component names, columns are attributes); the time-dependent counterpart is `buses_t`.

buses_t.description: Output: All time-dependent bus information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are bus names.

lines.description: Line components (Lines include distribution and transmission lines, overhead lines and cables), keyed by unique name. Emitted as lines.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to lines-<attribute>.csv. networks.csv also lists `lines` as an Output (pandas.DataFrame of all static Line information compiled by PyPSA from inputs: index is component names, columns are attributes); the time-dependent counterpart is `lines_t`.

lines_t.description: Output: All time-dependent line information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are line names.

components.description: Output: For each component type (buses, lines, etc.): static component information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Index is component names, columns are component attributes.

components_t.description: Output: For each component type (buses, lines, etc.): time-dependent component information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are component names.

branches().description: Output: Dynamically generated concatenation of branch DataFrames: network.lines, network.transformers and network.links. Note that this is a copy and therefore changing entries will NOT update the original.

meta.description: Dictionary of arbitrary network meta data (free-form). Defined on pypsa.Network as the `meta` property (pypsa/networks.py, v1.2.4); round-tripped by the CSV/netCDF/HDF5 importers and exporters.

pypsa_version.description: PyPSA version that wrote the input folder, stamped into network.csv by exporters and by this project's emitter (internal/target/pypsa/emitter.go, pypsaTargetVersion). Absence triggers a 'v0.0.0' import warning.

carriers.description: Carrier components (Carrier), keyed by unique name. Emitted as carriers.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to carriers-<attribute>.csv.

generators.description: Generator components (Power generator for the bus carrier it attaches to), keyed by unique name. Emitted as generators.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to generators-<attribute>.csv.

global_constraints.description: GlobalConstraint components (Constraints in the optimisation problem that apply to multiple components at once), keyed by unique name. Emitted as global_constraints.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to global_constraints-<attribute>.csv.

line_types.description: LineType components (Standard line types with per length values for impedances), keyed by unique name. Emitted as line_types.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to line_types-<attribute>.csv.

links.description: Link components (Link), keyed by unique name. Emitted as links.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to links-<attribute>.csv.

loads.description: Load components (Loads represent a demand at the bus they are connected to (e.g. PQ power consumer)), keyed by unique name. Emitted as loads.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to loads-<attribute>.csv.

processes.description: Process components (Process), keyed by unique name. Emitted as processes.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to processes-<attribute>.csv.

shapes.description: Shape components (Geographical shapes of network components), keyed by unique name. Emitted as shapes.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to shapes-<attribute>.csv.

shunt_impedances.description: ShuntImpedance components (Shunt with voltage-dependent admittance), keyed by unique name. Emitted as shunt_impedances.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to shunt_impedances-<attribute>.csv.

storage_units.description: StorageUnit components (Storage units enable inter-temporal energy shifting with fixed nominal-energy-to-nominal-power ratio), keyed by unique name. Emitted as storage_units.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to storage_units-<attribute>.csv.

stores.description: Store components (Stores provide fundamental inter-temporal storage functionality not limited in charging or discharging power), keyed by unique name. Emitted as stores.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to stores-<attribute>.csv.

sub_networks.description: SubNetwork components (Subsets of buses and passive branches (i.e. lines and transformers) that are connected (i.e. synchronous areas)), keyed by unique name. Emitted as sub_networks.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to sub_networks-<attribute>.csv. Output component: rows are computed by n.determine_network_topology(); do not set by hand.

transformers.description: Transformer components (2-winding transformer), keyed by unique name. Emitted as transformers.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to transformers-<attribute>.csv.

transformer_types.description: TransformerType components (Standard 2-winding transformer types), keyed by unique name. Emitted as transformer_types.csv in the CSV import folder; time-varying attributes are materialized to transformer_types-<attribute>.csv.

timeseries.description: Named time-series registry that SeriesRef strings resolve against (this project's canonical registry; internal/emit/timeseries.go).

constraints.description: Portable linear constraints that do not map onto GlobalConstraint rows; serialized to the _constraints.json sidecar and applied by run.py as linopy constraints.

scenarios.description: Two-stage stochastic scenarios; serialized to the _scenarios.json sidecar and applied by run.py after n.set_scenarios.

performance.description: Non-constant performance model specs the orchestrator precomputes/linearizes before the solve (_performance.json sidecar; model.PerfEntry).

Performance.description: Canonical performance spec (kind, parameters, precomputed series ref).

native.description: System-wide native PyPSA overrides passed through verbatim (_native.pypsa.json sidecar; per-component native.pypsa blocks merge as extra CSV columns instead).

Bus.title: Bus
Bus.description: Fundamental node where all components attach.

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of buses.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

type.description: Placeholder for bus type. Not implemented.

x.description: Longitude; the Spatial Reference System Identifier (SRID) is set in `n.srid`.

y.description: Latitude; the Spatial Reference System Identifier (SRID) is set in `n.srid`.

unit.description: Unit of the bus' carrier if the implicitly assumed unit ("MW") is inappropriate (e.g. "t/h"). Only descriptive. Does not influence any PyPSA functions. Default: None (unset).

location.description: Location of the bus. Does not influence the optimisation model but can be used for aggregation with `n.statistics`.

v_mag_pu_set.description: Voltage magnitude set point, per unit of `v_nom`. (per unit)

v_mag_pu_min.description: Minimum desired voltage, per unit of `v_nom`. Placeholder attribute not currently used by any functions. (per unit)

v_mag_pu_max.description: Maximum desired voltage, per unit of `v_nom`.  Placeholder attribute not currently used by any functions. (per unit) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

control.description: Output: P,Q,V control strategy for power flow, must be "PQ", "PV" or "Slack". Note that this attribute is an output inherited from the controls of the generators attached to the bus. Do not set by hand.

generator.description: Output: Name of slack generator attached to slack bus.

sub_network.description: Output: Name of connected sub-network to which bus belongs. This attribute is set by `n.determine_network_topology()`. Do not set by hand.

p.description: Output: active power at bus (positive if net generation at bus) (MW)

q.description: Output: reactive power (positive if net generation at bus) (MVar)

v_mag_pu.description: Output: Voltage magnitude, per unit of `v_nom` (per unit)

marginal_price.description: Output: Shadow price from energy balance constraint (currency/MWh)

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: Energy carriers of buses (e.g. "AC" for alternating current, "DC" for direct current, "hydrogen", or "heat") or technologies of other components (e.g. "wind", "gas turbine", "electrolyser", or "heat pump")

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of carriers.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

co2_emissions.description: Emissions in tCO~2~ per MWh of primary energy (e.g. methane has 0.2 tCO~2~/MWh~thermal~). (tonnes/MWh)

color.description: Color for plotting (e.g. `matplotlib` [named colors](https://matplotlib.org/stable/gallery/color/named_colors.html) or hexadecimal color codes like "#AB9812")

nice_name.description: Descriptive name for statistics and visualisations (e.g. "Natural Gas" for carrier `gas`)

max_growth.description: Maximum new installed capacity per investment period (MW) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

max_relative_growth.description: Maximum capacity ratio for new installed capacity per investment period

Generator.title: Generator
Generator.description: Power generator for the bus carrier it attaches to.

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of generators.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

bus.description: Required input: Name of bus to which generator is attached

control.description: P,Q,V control strategy for power flow, must be "PQ", "PV" or "Slack". Only relevant for "AC" and "DC" buses.

type.description: Placeholder for generator type. Not implemented.

p_nom.description: Nominal power for limits  on `p` in optimization. Ignored if `p_nom_extendable=True`. (MW)

p_nom_mod.description: Nominal power of the generator module (e.g. fixed unit size of a nuclear power plant). Introduces integer variables if set. (MW)

p_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `p_nom` to be extended in optimization.

p_nom_min.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its minimum value. (MW)

p_nom_max.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its maximum value (e.g. limited by technical potential). (MW) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

p_nom_set.description: If `p_nom` is extendable in optimization, set its value. (MW)

p_min_pu.description: The minimum output for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization (e.g. a minimal dispatch level for conventional power plants). Note that if `committable=False` and `p_min_pu>0`, this represents a must-run condition. (per unit)

p_max_pu.description: The maximum output for each snapshot per unit of `p_nom` for the optimization (e.g. changing availability of renewable generators due to weather conditions or a de-rating of conventional power plants). (per unit)

p_set.description: Active power set point (for optimisation and power flow) (MW)

p_init.description: Active power used as a starting point for limiting the ramp in the very first snapshot (for optimisation) (MW)

e_sum_min.description: The minimum total energy produced during a single optimization horizon. (MWh) Default: -inf (not representable in JSON).

e_sum_max.description: The maximum total energy produced during a single optimization horizon. (MWh) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

q_set.description: Reactive power set point (for power flow) (MVar)

sign.description: Sign denoting the orientation of the dispatch variable (e.g. positive for generation, negative for consumption).

carrier.description: Prime mover energy carrier (e.g. coal, gas, wind, solar); required for global constraints on primary energy in optimisation

marginal_cost.description: Marginal cost of production of 1 MWh. (currency/MWh)

marginal_cost_quadratic.description: Quadratic marginal cost of production of 1 MWh. (currency/MWh)

active.description: Whether to consider the component in optimization or not

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the generator. (years) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

capital_cost.description: Fixed period costs of extending `p_nom` by 1 MW (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly in optimization unless `overnight_cost` is specified. (currency/MW)

overnight_cost.description: Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MW. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`. (currency/MW) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation). (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

fom_cost.description: Fixed period operation and maintenance costs per MW, added to annuitized investment cost. (currency/MW)

efficiency.description: Ratio output and primary energy carrier input (e.g. 0.4 MWh~elec~/MWh~fuel~). This is required for global constraints on primary energy in optimization. (per unit)

start_up_cost.description: Cost to start up the generator. Only used if `committable=True`. (currency)

shut_down_cost.description: Cost to shut down the generator. Only used if `committable=True`. (currency)

stand_by_cost.description: Stand-by cost for running the generator. This cost is incurred whenever the status is 1 (including when the dispatch decision is zero). (currency/h)

min_up_time.description: Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 1. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (snapshots)

min_down_time.description: Minimum number of snapshots for status to be 0. Only used if `committable=True`. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (snapshots)

up_time_before.description: Number of snapshots that the generator was online before `n.snapshots` start. Only used if `committable=True` and `min_up_time>0`. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (snapshots)

down_time_before.description: Number of snapshots that the generator was offline before `n.snapshots` start. Only used if `committable=True` and `min_down_time>0`. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (snapshots)

ramp_limit_up.description: Maximum active power increase from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

ramp_limit_down.description: Maximum active power decrease from one snapshot to the next, per unit of the nominal power. Ignored if NaN. Does not consider snapshot weightings. (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

ramp_limit_start_up.description: Maximum active power increase at start up, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN. (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

ramp_limit_shut_down.description: Maximum active power decrease at shut down, per unit of the nominal power. Only used if `committable=True`. Ignored if NaN. (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

weight.description: Weighting of a generator. Only used for network clustering.

p.description: Output: Active power at bus (positive if net generation) (MW)

q.description: Output: Reactive power (positive if net generation) (MVar)

status.description: Output: Status in the snapshot (1 is on, 0 is off). Only returned if `committable=True`.

start_up.description: Output: Whether the unit was started in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `committable=True`.

shut_down.description: Output: Whether the unit was shut down in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no).  Only returned if `committable=True`.

mu_upper.description: Output: Shadow price of upper `p_nom` limit (currency/MWh)

mu_lower.description: Output: Shadow price of lower `p_nom` limit (currency/MWh)

mu_p_set.description: Output: Shadow price of fixed power generation `p_set` (currency/MWh)

mu_ramp_limit_up.description: Output: Shadow price of upper ramp up limit (currency/MWh)

mu_ramp_limit_down.description: Output: Shadow price of lower ramp down limit (currency/MWh)

GlobalConstraint.title: GlobalConstraint
GlobalConstraint.description: Constraints in the optimisation problem that apply to multiple components at once.

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of global_constraints.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

investment_period.description: Investment period for which the constraint is applied. If not specified, the constraint is applied to all investment periods together. Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

bus.description: Bus to which the global constraint applies. Only relevant for `type="tech_expansion_limit". If not specified, the constraint applies to all buses.

carrier_attribute.description: If the global constraint is connected with a carrier, name the associated carrier attribute. This must appear as a column in `n.carriers`.

sense.description: Constraint sense; must be one of <=, == or >=

constant.description: Constant for right-hand-side of constraint for optimisation period. For a CO~2~ constraint, this would be tonnes of CO~2~.

mu.description: Output: Shadow price of global constraint (currency/constant)

Line.title: Line
Line.description: Lines include distribution and transmission lines, overhead lines and cables.

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of lines.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

bus0.description: Required input: Name of origin bus to which branch is attached.

bus1.description: Required input: Name of destination bus to which branch is attached.

type.description: Name of line standard type. If this is not an empty string "", the line standard type impedance parameters are multiplied with the `length` and divided/multiplied by `num_parallel` to compute `x`, `r`, etc. This will override any values set in `r`, `x, and `b`. If the string is empty, values manually provided for `r`, `x`, etc. are taken.

x.description: Required input: Series reactance, must be non-zero for AC branch for linearised power flow equations. If the line has series inductance $L$ in Henries then $x = 2\\pi f L$ where $f$ is the frequency in Hertz. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for non-linear power flow calculations. Ignored if `type` defined. (Ohm)

r.description: Required input: Series resistance, must be non-zero for DC branch for linearised power flow equations. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for the non-linear power flow. Ignored if `type` defined. (Ohm)

g.description: Shunt conductivity. Shunt admittance is $y = g + jb$. (Siemens)

b.description: Shunt susceptance. If the line has shunt capacitance $C$ in Farads then $b = 2\\pi f C$ where $f$ is the frequency in Hertz. Shunt admittance is $y = g + jb$. Ignored if `type` defined. (Siemens)

s_nom.description: Limit of apparent power which can pass through branch in either direction. Ignored if `s_nom_extendable=True`. (MVA)

s_nom_mod.description: Modular unit size of line expansion of `s_nom` (e.g. fixed rating of added circuit). Introduces integer variables. (MVA)

s_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `s_nom` to be extended in optimisation.

s_nom_min.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the minimum value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA)

s_nom_max.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the maximum value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

s_nom_set.description: If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set the value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA)

s_max_pu.description: The maximum allowed absolute apparent power flow per unit of `s_nom` for the optimisation (e.g. can set `s_max_pu<1` to approximate $N-1$ contingency factor, or can be time-varying to represent weather-dependent dynamic line rating for overhead lines). (per unit)

capital_cost.description: Fixed period costs of extending `s_nom` by 1 MVA (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly unless `overnight_cost` is specified. Any `length` factor must already be included. (currency/MVA)

overnight_cost.description: Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MVA. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`. (currency/MVA) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation). (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

fom_cost.description: Fixed period operation and maintenance cost per MVA, added to annuitized investment cost. (currency/MVA)

active.description: Whether to consider the component in optimisation or not

lifetime.description: Lifetime of line. (years) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

length.description: Length of line used when `type` is set. Also useful for calculating `capital_cost`. (km)

carrier.description: Type of current. "AC" is the only valid value for lines.

terrain_factor.description: Terrain factor for increasing `length` for `capital_cost` calculation. (per unit)

num_parallel.description: When `type` is set, this is the number of parallel circuits. Can also be fractional. If `type` is empty "" this value is ignored.

v_ang_min.description: Minimum voltage angle difference across the line.  Placeholder attribute not currently used. (degrees) Default: -inf (not representable in JSON).

v_ang_max.description: Maximum voltage angle difference across the line. Placeholder attribute not currently used. (degrees) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

sub_network.description: Output: Name of sub-network to which lines belongs, as calculated by `n.determine_network_topology()`. Do not set by hand.

p0.description: Output: Active power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`). (MW)

q0.description: Output: Reactive power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`). (MVar)

p1.description: Output: Active power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`). (MW)

q1.description: Output: Reactive power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`). (MVar)

x_pu.description: Output: Per unit series reactance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x` and `n.buses.v_nom`. (per unit)

r_pu.description: Output: Per unit series resistance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r` and `n.buses.v_nom`. (per unit)

g_pu.description: Output: Per unit shunt conductivity calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `g` and `n.buses.v_nom`. (per unit)

b_pu.description: Output: Per unit shunt susceptance calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `b` and `n.buses.v_nom`. (per unit)

x_pu_eff.description: Output: Effective per unit series reactance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x` and `n.buses.v_nom` (per unit)

r_pu_eff.description: Output: Effective per unit series resistance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r` and `n.buses.v_nom` (per unit)

s_nom_opt.description: Output: Optimised nominal capacity for apparent power. (MVA)

mu_lower.description: Output: Shadow price of lower `s_nom` limit $-F \\leq f$. Always non-negative. (currency/MVA)

mu_upper.description: Output: Shadow price of upper `s_nom` limit $f \\leq F$. Always non-negative. (currency/MVA)

LineType.description: Standard line types with per length values for impedances. PyPSA v1.2.4 ships 60 standard line types in pypsa/data/standard_types/line_types.csv (e.g. "149-AL1/24-ST1A 110.0", "NAYY 4x50 SE", "Al/St 240/40 4-bundle 380.0", "HVDC XLPE 1000").

r_per_length.description: Required input: Series resistance per length (Ohm per km)

x_per_length.description: Required input: Series reactance per length (Ohm per km)

c_per_length.description: Shunt capacitance per length (nF per km)

mounting.description: Can be "ol" for overhead line or "cs" for cable

Link.title: Link
Link.description: Links are used for controllable directed flows between two or more buses with arbitrary energy carriers (e.g. HVDC links, converters, conversions between carriers).

NonFiniteNumber.title: Non-finite number literal
NonFiniteNumber.description: An IEEE-754 non-finite value spelled as a string, because JSON has no Infinity/NaN literals: 'inf' -> +Infinity, '-inf' -> -Infinity, 'NaN' -> Not-a-Number. These are the exact spellings pandas/PyPSA parse when reading the CSV import folder; consumers should map them to float('inf')/float('-inf')/float('nan'). In per-snapshot arrays, 'NaN' entries carry PyPSA's upstream meaning for that attribute (e.g. state_of_charge_set/e_set: no constraint at that snapshot).

bus1.description: Required input: Name of destination bus (typically lower voltage) to which transformer is attached.

type.description: Name of 2-winding transformer standard type. If this is not an empty string "", the transformer type impedance parameters are taken from the standard type along with `num_parallel`. This will override any values set in `r`, `x`, `g`, `b`, `s_nom`, `tap_ratio`, `tap_side` and `phase_shift`. If the string is empty, values manually provided for `r`, `x`, etc. are taken.

model.description: Required input: Model used for admittance matrix; can be "t" or "pi"; defaults to "t" following physics and DIgSILENT PowerFactory

x.description: Required input: Series reactance (per unit, using `s_nom` as base power and `v_nom` as base voltage); must be non-zero for AC branch in linear power flow. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for the non-linear power flow. Ignored if type defined. (per unit)

r.description: Required input: Series resistance (per unit, using `s_nom` as base power and `v_nom` as base voltage); must be non-zero for DC branch in linear power flow. Series impedance $z = r + jx$ must be non-zero for the non-linear power flow. Ignored if type defined. (per unit)

g.description: Shunt conductivity (per unit, using `s_nom` as base power and `v_nom` as base voltage). Ignored if type defined. (per unit)

b.description: Shunt susceptance (per unit, using `s_nom` as base power and `v_nom` as base voltage). Ignored if type defined. (per unit)

s_nom.description: Limit of apparent power which can pass through branch in either direction. Ignored if `s_nom_extendable=True`. (MVA)

s_nom_mod.description: Modular unit size of transformer expansion of `s_nom`. Introduces integer variables. (MVA)

s_nom_extendable.description: Switch to allow capacity `s_nom` to be extended in optimisation.

s_nom_min.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the minimum value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA)

s_nom_max.description: If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the maximum value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

s_nom_set.description: If `s_nom` is extendable in optimization, set the value of `s_nom_opt`. (MVA)

s_max_pu.description: The maximum allowed absolute flow per unit of `s_nom` for the oprimisation. (per unit)

capital_cost.description: Fixed period costs of extending `s_nom` by 1 MVA (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly unless `overnight_cost` is specified. (currency/MVA)

overnight_cost.description: Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MVA. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`. (currency/MVA) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

discount_rate.description: Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation). (per unit) Default: NaN (not representable in JSON).

fom_cost.description: Fixed period operation and maintenance costs, added to annuitized investment cost. (currency/MVA)

num_parallel.description: When `type` is set, this is the number of parallel transformers (can also be fractional). If `type` is empty "" this value is ignored.

tap_ratio.description: Ratio of per unit voltages at each bus for tap changed. Ignored if type defined. (per unit)

tap_side.description: Defines if tap changer is modelled at the primary 0 side (usually high-voltage) or the secondary 1 side (usually low voltage) (must be 0 or 1, defaults to 0). Ignored if type defined.

tap_position.description: If the transformer has a `type`, the absolute tap position on the same scale as `tap_min`/`tap_neutral`/`tap_max`. The off-nominal voltage ratio is computed from the offset to `tap_neutral`, so the nominal ratio (`tap_ratio` = 1) is obtained when `tap_position == tap_neutral`.

phase_shift.description: Voltage phase angle shift. Ignored if type defined. (Degrees)

active.description: Whether to consider the component in optimisation or not

lifetime.description: Lifetime of transformer. (years) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

v_ang_min.description: Minimum voltage angle difference across the transformer.Placeholder attribute not currently used. (Degrees) Default: -inf (not representable in JSON).

v_ang_max.description: Maximum voltage angle difference across the transformer.Placeholder attribute not currently used. (Degrees) Default: inf (not representable in JSON).

sub_network.description: Output: Name of connected sub-network to which transformer belongs, as calculated by `n.determine_network_topology()`. Do not set by hand.

p0.description: Output: Active power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`). (MW)

q0.description: Output: Reactive power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`). (MVar)

p1.description: Output: Active power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`). (MW)

q1.description: Output: Reactive power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`). (MVar)

x_pu.description: Output: Per unit series reactance rescaled to a 1 MVA base power by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x` via `x_pu = x / s_nom`. (per unit)

r_pu.description: Output: Per unit series resistance rescaled to a 1 MVA base power by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r` via `r_pu = r / s_nom`. (per unit)

g_pu.description: Output: Per unit shunt conductivity rescaled to a 1 MVA base power by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `g` via `g_pu = g * s_nom`. (per unit)

b_pu.description: Output: Per unit shunt susceptance rescaled to a 1 MVA base power by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `b` via `b_pu = b * s_nom`. (per unit)

x_pu_eff.description: Output: Effective per unit series reactance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `x_pu` and `tap_ratio` via `x_pu_eff = x_pu * tap_ratio`. (per unit)

r_pu_eff.description: Output: Effective per unit series resistance for linear power flow, calculated by `n.calculate_dependent_values()` from `r_pu` and `tap_ratio` via `r_pu_eff = r_pu * tap_ratio`. (per unit)

s_nom_opt.description: Output: Optimised nominal capacity for apparent power. (MVA)

mu_lower.description: Output: Shadow price of lower `s_nom` limit. Always non-negative. (currency/MVA)

mu_upper.description: Output: Shadow price of upper `s_nom` limit. Always non-negative. (currency/MVA)

TransformerType.title: TransformerType
TransformerType.description: Standard 2-winding transformer types. PyPSA v1.2.4 ships 14 standard transformer types in pypsa/data/standard_types/transformer_types.csv (e.g. "0.25 MVA 10/0.4 kV", "100 MVA 220/110 kV", "160 MVA 380/110 kV").

name.description: Required input: Unique name Serves as the object key in this document and as the `name` index column of transformer_types.csv in the emitted CSV import folder.

v_nom_0.description: Required input: Nominal voltage on high voltage side (kV)

v_nom_1.description: Required input: Nominal voltage on low voltage side (kV)

vscr.description: Required input: Real part of short circuit voltage (Percent)

pfe.description: Required input: No load (open circuit) iron losses (kW)

i0.description: Required input: No load (open circuit) current (Percent)

tap_side.description: Required input: Defines if tap changer is modelled at the primary 0 side (usually high-voltage) or the secondary 1 side (usually low voltage) (must be 0 or 1, defaults to 0)

tap_neutral.description: Required input: Rated tap position, i.e. position at which the winding ratio corresponds to the ratio of the rated voltages

tap_step.description: Required input: Tap step size in percentage of voltage change (Percent)

Network.title: Network
Network.description: Network-level attributes from pypsa/data/component_attrs/networks.csv (v1.2.4), plus `meta` and the exporter-stamped `pypsa_version`. In the emitted CSV import folder these become network.csv (name, pypsa_version, srid, ...), snapshots.csv, investment_periods.csv and the weighting columns.

snapshots.description: List of snapshots or time steps. All time-dependent series quantities are indexed by `network.snapshots`. To reset the snapshots, call `network.set_snapshots(new)`.

oneOf.description: Timestamp label, e.g. '2025-01-01 00:00:00' (this project's snapshots.csv format from internal/emit.SnapshotLabels) or an integer index rendered as string.

prefixItems.description: Investment period (multi-horizon: first level of the pandas.MultiIndex).

oneOf.description: Multi-horizon snapshot as a (period, timestep) pair; used when investment_periods is set.

snapshot_weightings.description: The weightings applied to each snapshot, so that snapshots can represent more than one hour or fractions of one hour. The objective weightings are used to weight snapshots in the objective function. The store weightings determine the state of charge change for stores and storage units. The generator weightings are used when calculating global constraints and energy balances. (hours)

investment_periods.description: Time periods of investment. Only used for multi investment optimisation. Years have to be integer and increasing (e.g. [2025,2030,2035]). Default is an empty pd.Index([]). (years)

items.description: Investment period year; must be integer and increasing (e.g. [2025, 2030, 2035]).

investment_period_weightings.description: Weightings applied to each investment period. Objective weightings are multiplied with all cost coefficients in the objective function of the respective investment period (e.g. used to include social discount rate). Years weighting denote the elapsed time until the subsequent investment period (e.g. used for global constraints CO2 emissions). Upstream default: 1.0 (each column defaults to a weighting of 1 per investment period).

now.description: The current snapshot/time/scenario, relevant e.g. when `network.pf()` is called without a snapshot argument.

srid.description: Spatial Reference System Indentifier for x,y coordinates of buses. It defaults to standard longitude and latitude.

crs.description: Coordinate Reference System for the Shape components. It defaults to standard longitude and latitude, given in srid.

buses.description: Output: All static bus information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Index is bus names, columns are bus attributes.

buses_t.description: Output: All time-dependent bus information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are bus names.

lines.description: Output: All static line information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Index is line names, columns are line attributes.

lines_t.description: Output: All time-dependent line information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are line names.

components.description: Output: For each component type (buses, lines, etc.): static component information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Index is component names, columns are component attributes.

components_t.description: Output: For each component type (buses, lines, etc.): time-dependent component information compiled by PyPSA from inputs. Dictionary keys are time-dependent series attributes, index is network.snapshots, columns are component names.

branches().description: Output: Dynamically generated concatenation of branch DataFrames: network.lines, network.transformers and network.links. Note that this is a copy and therefore changing entries will NOT update the original.

meta.description: Dictionary of arbitrary network meta data (free-form). Defined on pypsa.Network as the `meta` property (pypsa/networks.py, v1.2.4); round-tripped by the CSV/netCDF/HDF5 importers and exporters.

pypsa_version.description: PyPSA version that wrote the input folder, stamped into network.csv by exporters and by this project's emitter (internal/target/pypsa/emitter.go, pypsaTargetVersion). Absence triggers a 'v0.0.0' import warning.

SeriesRef.title: Named time-series reference
SeriesRef.description: Reference to a named series in the top-level `timeseries` registry: the series id, optionally prefixed with 'ts:' (e.g. "pv_cf" or "ts:pv_cf"). Matches this project's canonical Value type (internal/model/types.go) resolved by internal/emit/timeseries.go SeriesValues. Bare references must not collide with the non-finite number literals 'inf'/'-inf'/'NaN' (see $defs/NonFiniteNumber); a series actually named like one of them must be referenced with the explicit 'ts:' prefix.

StaticOrSeries.title: Static value or time series
StaticOrSeries.description: A PyPSA 'static or series' attribute: a scalar applied to every snapshot, an array of per-snapshot values aligned with `snapshots`, or a named reference into the top-level `timeseries` registry. When materialized to the CSV import folder, per-snapshot values are written to `<list_name>-<attribute>.csv` (a `snapshot` index column plus one column per component name), as produced by internal/target/pypsa/materialize.go. Non-finite scalars are spelled per $defs/NonFiniteNumber; they never denote a series reference (bare series ids colliding with those literals need the 'ts:' prefix).

oneOf.description: Per-snapshot values, same length/order as `snapshots`. Entries may use the non-finite literals of $defs/NonFiniteNumber.

Series.title: Time series (snapshot-indexed)
Series.description: A snapshot-indexed series: an array aligned with `snapshots`, a scalar (constant series), or a named reference into the `timeseries` registry. Solver outputs of dtype 'series' use this shape when serialized. Non-finite scalars are spelled per $defs/NonFiniteNumber; they never denote a series reference (bare series ids colliding with those literals need the 'ts:' prefix).

oneOf.description: Entries may use the non-finite literals of $defs/NonFiniteNumber.

SnapshotWeightings.title: Snapshot weightings
SnapshotWeightings.description: Per-snapshot weightings (default 1 for every snapshot, unit: hours). Columns of n.snapshot_weightings: `objective` weights snapshots in the objective function; `generators` is used when calculating global constraints and energy balances; `stores` determines the state-of-charge change for stores and storage units. A bare number applies one weight to all snapshots and columns; an object sets each column to a scalar or a per-snapshot array. In a CSV import folder these are extra columns of snapshots.csv.

objective.description: Weighting of each snapshot in the objective function (hours). Default 1.

generators.description: Weighting of each snapshot in global constraints and energy balances (hours). Default 1.

stores.description: Weighting of each snapshot for the state-of-charge change of stores and storage units (hours). Default 1.

InvestmentPeriodWeightings.title: Investment period weightings
InvestmentPeriodWeightings.description: Weightings applied to each investment period (multi-horizon optimisation). `objective` is multiplied with all cost coefficients of the respective investment period (e.g. social discount rate); `years` denotes the elapsed time until the subsequent investment period (e.g. for global constraints such as CO2 emissions). Arrays align with `investment_periods`.

objective.description: Objective weighting per investment period. Default 1.

years.description: Elapsed years until the subsequent investment period. Default 1.

TimeSeries.title: Time-series registry entry
TimeSeries.description: A named time series that SeriesRef strings point at (this project's model.TimeSeries, internal/model/model.go).

ConstraintTerm.title: Sidecar linear-constraint term
ConstraintTerm.description: One term of a portable linear constraint applied by run.py as a linopy constraint (internal/model/constraint.go Term; interpreted by internal/scripts/pypsa_run.py term_expr over generators, links and storage_units).

variable.description: Model variable the term sums: capacity (p_nom), flow_out/flow_in (dispatch p), or storage_cap (p_nom * max_hours of storage units). Emissions terms are not supported in the sidecar (carrier-wide emission accounting uses GlobalConstraint rows instead).

techs.description: Scope: canonical tech ids (matches id and id@node expansions); empty = all.

nodes.description: Scope: nodes (matched against the bus/bus0 node part of 'node::carrier' bus ids); empty = all.

SidecarConstraint.title: Sidecar linear constraint
SidecarConstraint.description: A portable linear constraint that does not project onto a PyPSA GlobalConstraint row; emitted to _constraints.json and applied by run.py via linopy m.add_constraints (name prefixed 'meme-').

period.description: Investment period the constraint applies to (optional).

ScenarioSet.title: Stochastic scenario assignment
ScenarioSet.description: One attribute assignment applied to the scenario-expanded network after n.set_scenarios (internal/target/pypsa/scenarios.go ScenarioSet; _scenarios.json sidecar): df.loc[(scenario, component), attribute] = value.

table.description: Component table (list_name) on the network, e.g. "generators", "loads", "links", "storage_units".

component.description: Canonical component id; matches the id and its per-node expansions id@node.

StochasticScenario.title: Stochastic scenario
StochasticScenario.description: One scenario of a two-stage stochastic run (mode "stochastic"): run.py calls n.set_scenarios({name: weight}) and applies each set.
